ecological_question: Does repeatable individual place-by-height organization persist when vertical state is defined relative to terrain rather than mean sea level?

vertical_axis.semantics: height above ground level from 30 m ASTER DEM, meters

primary_endpoint: held-out mean log P_self(AGL_bin|x,y) - log P_other_individuals(AGL_bin|x,y)

decomposition.marginal_identity: same-individual AGL marginal versus other-individual AGL marginal
decomposition.identity_x_location: conditional identity gain minus marginal identity gain

claim_boundary: positive transfer supports repeatable individual organization of flight height above ground
does not establish intrinsic personality or causal preference
cannot alter the frozen AMSL result or the closed uplift reaction-norm result
